_comment: Arm 2: flattened/tabular control (#10). OS endpoint, 20-Study cohort, 5-fold Study-stratified CV (#7), stratified Efron Cox loss and lifelines CoxPHFitter decoder locked by #3, feature contract locked by #4 and amended on #12.
_contract_amendment: Re-run on #12 (2026-08-09) because the shared feature contract changed: the Condition feature keys on conditionId rather than the corrupt conditionName (#4 §2's amendment). This widens the design matrix from ~74 to 167 columns (121 Condition levels against 28 names). Arms 2 and 3 must carry identical features or their difference is an encoding artifact rather than a structural result, so the earlier arm-2 numbers are superseded rather than comparable.
